title: Dr. William Davies Hutchings Office, 718 West Third Street, Madison, Jefferson County, IN
notes: Significance: Dr. Hutchings' Office was erected circa 1846-48.  It is an excellent example of a conservatively designed Greek Revival building.  Between 1848 and 1903 the structure was used as the offices of two lawyers and a doctor, each a well-known professional figure in Indiana.  Hutchings' office is the finest local example of a nineteenth century office building which was constructed in association with a residence.  The residence, however, was demolished in 1969.
